steps.1: Squeeze the front brake once and watch both pads land on the rim.
steps.2: Turn the bike over, flip the lever open, and lift the frame so the wheel drops out.
steps.3: Unscrew the nut and slide the skewer out. Each spring points its narrow end toward the hub.
steps.4: Lift the wheel and give it a spin, then run your fingers round the flat band the pads touch.
steps.5: Look at the brake from above. Each pad should face the rim's braking track.
steps.6: Set the wheel back between the fork blades with the tire's arrow pointing forward. Check the back tire the same way.
steps.7: Slide the skewer back through the hub, lever on the left, and thread the nut on.
steps.8: Snug the nut, then fold the lever flat along the fork, pointing up.
steps.9: Turn the bike upright. Spin the wheel and squeeze the brake.
